title: Degree-one prime coefficients as a Frobenius fixed-point kernel
statement: Let f : X → S be proper and smooth with nonempty geometrically connected one-dimensional fibres over a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme S. Let p be prime and suppose p = 0 in Γ(S, O_S). There exist a finite locally free quasi-coherent O_S-module E and an additive endomorphism F of its lifted associated etale sheaf satisfying F(ae) = a^p F(e) on every etale object, such that the underlying abelian sheaf of R^1 f_* of the constant lifted F_p-module is isomorphic to kernel(F - identity). Direct images use [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], geometric stalks use [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and the subsequent finite-module constructibility convention is [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. This conclusion is a kernel realization, without an assertion that the kernel is constructible.

proof.text: Pull p = 0 back to X. Apply the fully proved section-map constructor from the Artin--Schreier section-data module directly to X.etaleAdditiveSheaf, with its canonical ULift.down coordinates and definitional restriction identity. Apply the specified exactness theorem to obtain a short exact complex with map w(x) = x^p - x. This avoids transporting the tensor-unit model.

The structure-direct-image theorem supplies f_*O_X = O_S and the finite locally free quasi-coherent module E, its specified first-image isomorphism e, and scalar normalization on raw classes. Apply Artin--Schreier exactness on S itself. Structural function pullback intertwines the two Artin--Schreier maps, so f_*w is epic. This avoids the rank-one Frobenius vector-bundle theorem.

Use the universal right-derived delta functor of abelian lowerStar. Naturality of the degree-zero identification transports epimorphy to R0(w); epi cancellation makes the connecting map zero. Exactness at R1(constant Z/p) gives a monomorphism, and exactness at R1(O_X) identifies it with the kernel of R1(w). Transport from ordinary right-derived functors to bounded-below derived homology using the natural single-complex comparison.

Set phi = w + identity, and F = e.inv followed by R1(phi) followed by e.hom. On each localized coefficient sheaf, the section formula for phi and (ab)^p = a^p b^p show that multiplication by a followed by phi equals phi followed by multiplication by a^p. Apply the restricted cohomology functor. Use the specified raw comparison isomorphism and the canonical cocycle class map normalizationIota. The resolution-class theorem identifies its composite with raw evaluation as the prescribed abelianHigherDirectImageClass. The proved coefficient identities from raw restricted class normalization give coefficient naturality of normalizationIota. Surjectivity of raw evaluation transports the structure theorem's scalar normalization to restricted cohomology; the commuting coefficient endomorphisms then give semilinearity on raw classes. The canonical presheaf class map is locally surjective. The tensor-section restriction scalar identity and sheaf separation extend the equation to every section. Private structures package the actual associated sheaf and scalar endomorphisms, and the actual raw class, evaluation, and canonical cocycle maps with their proved laws. The semilinearity and local-to-global arguments use these abstract laws, avoiding repeated unfolding of tensor-pullback and derived cohomology data. The packages construct no new or unspecified coefficient object or comparison.

Additivity gives F - identity = e.inv followed by R1(w) followed by e.hom, so kernel.mapIso transports the preceding kernel identification. Exact coefficient forgetting commutes with derived homology; its canonical derived direct-image comparison and the constant-sheaf coefficient comparison identify the left side with the forgotten prime-module higher direct image. Compose these actual isomorphisms. All steps include the empty scheme and nonreduced characteristic-p bases.

theorem exists_prime_curve_artinSchreier_kernel
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian S] [CompactSpace S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] [Smooth f] [GeometricallyConnected f]
    (hdim : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber s) = 1)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : (p : Γ(S, ⊤)) = 0) :
    ∃ (E : S.Modules) (_ : E.IsFiniteLocallyFree) (_ : E.IsQuasicoherent)
      (F : Scheme.Modules.liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf E ⟶
        Scheme.Modules.liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf E),
      (∀ (U : S.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : ULift.{u + 1} Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
        (e : ULift.{u + 1} Γ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback U.unop.hom).obj E, ⊤)),
        F.hom.app U (ULift.up (a.down • e.down)) =
          ULift.up (a.down ^ p •
            (@id Γ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback U.unop.hom).obj E, ⊤)
              (F.hom.app U e).down))) ∧
      Nonempty ((moduleAbelianForget (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod p)) S).obj
        (higherDirectImage (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod p)) f 1
          ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology _).obj
            (ModuleCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod p)) (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod p))))) ≅
        kernel (F - 𝟙 _))
